title.rendered: Hawks View Office Closed 6/16 – 8/15 for Summer Break

content.rendered: Hawks View Elementary office will be closed June 16th through August 15th for summer break, reopening on August 18th. If you need to register a new student, you may register online by following the links here. If you need immediate assistance, please contact our District Office at 503-825-5000, from 7:30am to 4:00pm, Monday – Thursday.
